WHY ASSERT BEFORE WAIT. The receiver
raises CTS IN RESPONSE to RTS. A driver
that waited for CTS before asserting RTS
would wait for ever on a receiver that
only raises CTS when asked — a deadlock
no amount of correct bit-banging fixes,
and one a testbench that drives CTS
low-then-high can make look like a hang
rather than like an ordering mistake.
